environment.description: Same Lambda function deployed in ECS Fargate task (container image with Lambda Web Adapter). Task definition specifies linuxParameters with capabilities dropped: CAP_NET_RAW, CAP_SYS_ADMIN, CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE. Container runs as non-root (uid 1000). The ECS service sits behind an ALB with an AWS WAFv2 WebACL. The WebACL includes a custom rule group 'oauth-redirect-validation' with a regex pattern set that inspects the 'redirect_uri' query parameter value using a URI-decoded transformation, matching against pattern `^https://(app|dashboard|mobile)\.example\.com(/.*)?$` — requests not matching this pattern on paths /oauth/* receive BLOCK action with 403 response. Additionally, the WebACL has a rate-based rule (2000 req/5min per IP). The ALB access logs are shipped to CloudWatch with metric filters on 403 responses.
